If Sky chooses it, the line continues over the island and up Crown Avenue, then turns west on Crown Road at R50 to the sheet edge.

I am not proposing a two-way Sky Loop. The concept [cfba…] uses one straight S1 trunk, and retiring the loops is for Sky to decide [c190…]. At a ring corner, an R70 fillet (skyrail.radiusLine) sits about 29 m inside the vertex, but the kerb corner of two 24 m roads is only about 17 m in. The beam would pass over corner plots, which fails S-C1.

T2 runs through and leaves the sheet at both ends. Nothing on the sheet has the street space for a loop of R25 or more, and there is no street south of Comet Row, so T2 cannot end inside the sheet (T-L1). Route: from the north sheet edge down Harbour Road, west along Market Street (crossing T1 on the level), then down Sunset Way to the south sheet edge. Both ends reach the sheet edge (N-D1). It is one path, so it needs no order (N-O1).

Interchange room for N-C1 (Vantage places the stops). T2 crosses T1 at the Boulevard and Market Street (0,-416.5), 36 m from T1's Records stop at (0,-380). T2 passes under S1 at (306.5,0), 33.5 m from Harbour station at (340,0). Both are within skyrail.interchange 150.
